description: The AWESOME project deposits its Nile-region energy-system optimisation model and associated data as one public 77 MB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The Zenodo page says the archive contains the scripts and essential inputs for an OSeMOSYS energy-supply-chain model covering Egypt, Ethiopia and Sudan. It describes future energy demand, installed capacity and generation scenarios linked to socioeconomic and climate pathways. Modellers could run or adapt this regional model to test infrastructure evolution and water-energy-food trade-offs. The existing catalogue OSeMOSYS record describes the general modelling system; this deposit is a particular study model with its own geographic scope and files. A limitation is that the archive was not downloaded or executed, so claims about complete dependencies, solver requirements, data schemas and reproducibility remain provider statements. Some scenario inputs originate in other AWESOME deposits and may need separate access and citation. The ZIP is not evidence that model outputs have been independently validated or that every upstream input is freely redistributable.
